title: Only Slows the Movement
text: Only Slows the Movement. Sadly, while it helps to slow down the chair cushion's movement, it doesn't eliminate the movement. If you want complete elimination of the cushion sliding forward, this product is not the one to buy.

product_metadata.title: Cushion Grip Non-Slip Couch Underlay Pad, Keep Chair Cushions in Place, Stop Sofa Cushions from Sliding (24x24 inch) - 1 Pack
features: ✔ Super strength cushion grip helps locks cushions in place, help to stop cushions from sliding.
Rug pad can be easily trimmed to fit cushion sizes.
